hard_rules: Never merge to main; draft PRs only.
Never modify the local RL pilot (main checkout on feat/rl-engine-pilot, 10 unpushed commits).

Public repo: no lecture material, books, learner records, secrets or local absolute paths.
No clinical or safety-critical competence certification.
Do not overwrite other agents' or people's work; check open PRs/branches before writing.

critical_defects.text: Anki export identity (anki_v2.build_deck, used by chapter_publish, anki_bridge, experience_anki): (a) every export sets mod=stamp on ALL notes and both note types, so an 'update if newer' import overwrites learner edits to note fields and templates even when content is unchanged; (b) note-type IDs are hashed from the display name ('Exam Mastery · Basis (v2)'), so any rename (Mastery brand) creates new note types; (c) GUID includes the chapter slug, moving a card creates a new note; (d) deck names follow unit titles; (e) '_'-prefixed font media are never updated by Anki. Review history itself is preserved (cards are not changed). Source: R8 EF-1..EF-8 (PR #44), confirmed in code by lead.
critical_defects.fix: P4 candidate: stamp only notes/note types whose content hash changed (per-key state), freeze note-type IDs independent of display names before any brand presentation change, versioned media names; verify with disposable-collection import tests (anki library, never the learner's collection).
